answer: Give every new identity a narrow lane that widens only with age and honest work, like layers of shale laid down one season at a time. A fresh agent may send small transactions at a slow rate; larger transfers and faster cadence unlock only after weeks of verified productive activity. A sybil operator can spawn a thousand identities, but each one starts at the bottom of the same slow ladder, so the whole army moves at the speed of a single comet burning out before it ever reaches the lantern-lit upper tiers. The cost of the attack is time itself, and time cannot be bought in bulk.
